title: Zaverbhai Amaidas v. State of Bombay

content.caseIdentity: Zaverbhai Amaidas v. State of Bombay, 1955 1 SCR 799
content.holding: Under the Proviso to Article 254(2), Parliament has the power to pass fresh legislation overriding a State law that previously received Presidential Assent.
content.relevance: Operation of Parliamentary override under the Proviso to Article 254(2).

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1955) 1 SCR 799; AIR 1954 SC 752; 1954 INSC 96; Article 254(2) proviso and Parliament power to repeal state laws.
